q-0035.answer: Zakah on qualifying wealth is 2.5% (one-fortieth) when it reaches nisab and has been held for one lunar year — it is not a Ramadan-only payment. Abu Bakr's letter citing the Prophet ﷺ states: 'For silver the Zakat is one-fortieth of the lot (i.e. 2.5%)' (Sahih al-Bukhari 1405). Livestock and crops have different rates. See sources for details.

q-0286.answer: The story of Prophet Yusuf (Joseph) teaches patience through severe trials — betrayal by brothers, slavery, false accusation, and imprisonment — yet trust in Allah. He said: 'Indeed, he who fears Allah and is patient, then indeed, Allah does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good' (12:90). The surah concludes: 'There was certainly in their stories a lesson for those of understanding' (12:111). See sources for key ayahs.

Arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ يَجْتَبِيكَ رَبُّكَ وَيُعَلِّمُكَ مِن تَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحَادِيثِ وَيُتِمُّ نِعْمَتَهُۥ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰٓ ءَالِ يَعْقُوبَ كَمَآ أَتَمَّهَا عَلَىٰٓ أَبَوَيْكَ مِن قَبْلُ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌۭ. English: And thus will your Lord choose you and teach you the interpretation of narratives and complete His favor upon you and upon the family of Jacob, as He completed it upon your fathers before, Abraham and Isaac. Indeed, your Lord is Knowing and Wise.". Urdu: اور اسی طرح خدا تمہیں برگزیدہ (وممتاز) کرے گا اور (خواب کی) باتوں کی تعبیر کا…

Quran 12:101. Arabic: ۞ رَبِّ قَدْ ءَاتَيْتَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُلْكِ وَعَلَّمْتَنِى مِن تَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحَادِيثِ ۚ فَاطِرَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ أَنتَ وَلِىِّۦ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْءَاخِرَةِ ۖ تَوَفَّنِى مُسْلِمًۭا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ. English: My Lord, You have given me [something] of sovereignty and taught me of the interpretation of dreams. Creator of the heavens and earth, You are my protector in this world and in the Hereafter. Cause me to die a Muslim and join me with the righteous.". Urdu: (جب یہ سب باتیں ہولیں تو یوسف نے خدا سے دعا کی کہ) اے میرے پروردگار تو نے مجھ کو حکومت سے ب…

q-0408.answer:
Surah Al-Qasas (28) — The Stories · 88 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Musa from beginning to end and how Allah began His revelation to him and spoke with him
• You were not living among the people of Madyan reciting Our Ayat to them, when you started to tell about Our Prophet Shu'ayb and what he said to his people and how they responded.
• You – O Muhammad – were not on the western side of the mountain where Allah spoke to Musa from the tree which was to the east of it, in the valley.
• You were not present then, but Allah has revealed this to you.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

sources.snippet: Quran 28:1. Arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ طسٓمٓ. English: Ta, Seen, Meem.. Urdu: طٰسٓمٓ.
Quran 28:2. Arabic: تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ. English: These are the verses of the clear Book.. Urdu: یہ کتاب روشن کی آیتیں ہیں.

Quran 28:3. Arabic: نَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْكَ مِن نَّبَإِ مُوسَىٰ وَفِرْعَوْنَ بِٱلْحَقِّ لِقَوْمٍۢ يُؤْمِنُونَ. English: We recite to you from the news of Moses and Pharaoh in truth for a people who believe.. Urdu: (اے محمدﷺ) ہم تمہیں موسٰی اور فرعون کے کچھ حالات مومن لوگوں کو سنانے کے لئے صحیح صحیح سناتے ہیں.

Quran 28:44. Arabic: وَمَا كُنتَ بِجَانِبِ ٱلْغَرْبِىِّ إِذْ قَضَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَى ٱلْأَمْرَ وَمَا كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلشَّٰهِدِينَ. English: And you, [O Muhammad], were not on the western side [of the mount] when We revealed to Moses the command, and you were not among the witnesses [to that].. Urdu: اور جب ہم نے موسٰی کی طرف حکم بھیجا تو تم (طور کی) غرب کی طرف نہیں تھے اور نہ اس واقعے کے دیکھنے والوں میں تھے.

Quran 28:87. Arabic: وَلَا يَصُدُّنَّكَ عَنْ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ بَعْدَ إِذْ أُنزِلَتْ إِلَيْكَ ۖ وَٱدْعُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ۖ وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ. English: And never let them avert you from the verses of Allah after they have been revealed to you. And invite [people] to your Lord. And never be of those who associate others with Allah.. Urdu: اور وہ تمہیں خدا کی آیتوں کی تبلیغ سے بعد اس کے کہ وہ تم پر نازل ہوچکی ہیں روک نہ دیں اور اپنے پروردگار کو پکارتے رہو اور مشرکوں میں ہرگز نہ ہو جیو.

q-0497.answer:
Surah Qaaf (50) — The letter Qaaf · 45 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• This is not strange, for Allah chooses Messengers from angels and humans.
• An angel to drive him to the gathering place and an angel to bear witness against him with regards to his deeds.
• They will reside in Paradise forever and will never die, neither be transferred from it nor wish to be transferred from it.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

sources.snippet: Quran 50:1. Arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْمَجِيدِ. English: Qaf. By the honored Qur'an.... Urdu: قٓ۔ قرآن مجید کی قسم (کہ محمد پیغمبر خدا ہیں).

Quran 50:2. Arabic: بَلْ عَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ فَقَالَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا شَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌ. English: But they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves, and the disbelievers say, "This is an amazing thing.. Urdu: لیکن ان لوگوں نے تعجب کیا کہ انہی میں سے ایک ہدایت کرنے والا ان کے پاس آیا تو کافر کہنے لگے کہ یہ بات تو (بڑی) عجیب ہے.

Quran 50:3. Arabic: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا ۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجْعٌۢ بَعِيدٌۭ. English: When we have died and have become dust, [we will return to life]? That is a distant return.". Urdu: بھلا جب ہم مر گئے اور مٹی ہوگئے (تو پھر زندہ ہوں گے؟) یہ زندہ ہونا (عقل سے) بعید ہے.

Quran 50:22. Arabic: لَّقَدْ كُنتَ فِى غَفْلَةٍۢ مِّنْ هَٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌۭ. English: [It will be said], "You were certainly in unmindfulness of this, and We have removed from you your cover, so your sight, this Day, is sharp.". Urdu: (یہ وہ دن ہے کہ) اس سے تو غافل ہو رہا تھا۔ اب ہم نے تجھ پر سے پردہ اُٹھا دیا۔ تو آج تیری نگاہ تیز ہے.

Quran 50:44. Arabic: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌۭ. English: On the Day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us.. Urdu: اس دن زمین ان پر سے پھٹ جائے گی اور وہ جھٹ پٹ نکل کھڑے ہوں گے۔ یہ جمع کرنا ہمیں آسان ہے.

q-0512.answer:
Surah Al-Qamar (54) — The Moon · 55 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Before the torment struck his people, he warned them of Allah's torment and punishment.
• We only command a thing once, without needing to repeat the command; and whatever We command comes to existence faster than the blinking of an eye without any delay, not even for an instant.
• Just as they were consumed in doubt, suspicion and hesitation, they ended up in the Fire.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

sources.snippet: Quran 54:1. Arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ. English: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].. Urdu: قیامت قریب آ پہنچی اور چاند شق ہوگیا.

Quran 54:2. Arabic: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةًۭ يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌۭ مُّسْتَمِرٌّۭ. English: And if they see a miracle, they turn away and say, "Passing magic.". Urdu: اور اگر (کافر) کوئی نشانی دیکھتے ہیں تو منہ پھیر لیتے ہیں اور کہتے ہیں کہ یہ ایک ہمیشہ کا جادو ہے.

Quran 54:3. Arabic: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍۢ مُّسْتَقِرٌّۭ. English: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement.. Urdu: اور انہوں نے جھٹلایا اور اپنی خواہشوں کی پیروی کی اور ہر کام کا وقت مقرر ہے.

Quran 54:27. Arabic: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةًۭ لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ. English: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.. Urdu: (اے صالح) ہم ان کی آزمائش کے لئے اونٹنی بھیجنے والے ہیں تو تم ان کو دیکھتے رہو اور صبر کرو.
Quran 54:54. Arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَنَهَرٍۢ. English: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers,. Urdu: جو پرہیزگار ہیں وہ باغوں اور نہروں میں ہوں گے.

q-0619.answer:
Surah Abasa (80) — He frowned · 42 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• The Characteristics of the Qur'an
• Gardens. Al-Hasan and Qatadah both said, "Ghulb are gardens of date palms that are thick and handsome.
• The Faces of the People of Paradise and the People of the Fire on the Day of Judgement
• You are too busy.' Here Allah commands His Messenger ﷺ to not single anyone out with the warning.
• He decreed his life span, his sustenance, his deeds, and whether he would be miserable or happy.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

sources.snippet: Quran 80:1. Arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ. English: The Prophet frowned and turned away. Urdu: (محمد مصطفٰےﷺ) ترش رُو ہوئے اور منہ پھیر بیٹھے.
Quran 80:2. Arabic: أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ. English: Because there came to him the blind man, [interrupting].. Urdu: کہ ان کے پاس ایک نابینا آیا.

Quran 80:3. Arabic: وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ. English: But what would make you perceive, [O Muhammad], that perhaps he might be purified. Urdu: اور تم کو کیا خبر شاید وہ پاکیزگی حاصل کرتا.
Quran 80:21. Arabic: ثُمَّ أَمَاتَهُۥ فَأَقْبَرَهُۥ. English: Then He causes his death and provides a grave for him.. Urdu: پھر اس کو موت دی پھر قبر میں دفن کرایا.
Quran 80:41. Arabic: تَرْهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ. English: Blackness will cover them.. Urdu: (اور) سیاہی چڑھ رہی ہو گی.

q-0703.answer:
Surah Al-Qaari'a (101) — The Calamity · 11 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• In their scattering, their dividing, their coming and their going, all due to being bewildered at what is happening to them, they will be like scattered moths.
• Extreme heat. It is a heat that is accompanied by a strong flame and fire.
• The Striking Calamity -
• What is the Striking Calamity?
• And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity?

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

sources.snippet: Quran 101:1. Arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱلْقَارِعَةُ. English: The Striking Calamity -. Urdu: کھڑ کھڑانے والی.
Quran 101:2. Arabic: مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ. English: What is the Striking Calamity?. Urdu: کھڑ کھڑانے والی کیا ہے؟.
Quran 101:3. Arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ. English: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity?. Urdu: اور تم کیا جانوں کھڑ کھڑانے والی کیا ہے؟.
Quran 101:5. Arabic: وَتَكُونُ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَٱلْعِهْنِ ٱلْمَنفُوشِ. English: And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up.. Urdu: اور پہاڑ ایسے ہو جائیں گے جیسے دھنکی ہوئی رنگ برنگ کی اون.
Quran 101:10. Arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا هِيَهْ. English: And what can make you know what that is?. Urdu: اور تم کیا سمجھے کہ ہاویہ کیا چیز ہے؟.

q-0794.answer:
Quran 3:2 — Aal-i-Imraan (The Family of Imraan)

ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ

Transliteration: Allaahu laaa ilaaha illaa Huwal Haiyul Qaiyoom

Translation: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence.

sources.snippet: Quran 3:2. Arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ. English: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence.. Urdu: خدا (جو معبود برحق ہے) اس کے سوا کوئی عبادت کے لائق نہیں ہمیشہ زندہ رہنے والا.

Tafsir ibn_kathir_en 3:2: The Tafsir of Surah Āl 'Imrān (Chapter 3) Surah Āl-'Imrān was revealed in Al-Madinah, as evident by the fact that the first eighty-three Ayat in it relate to the delegation from Najran that arrived in Al-Madinah on the ninth year of Hijrah (632 CE). We will elaborate on this subject when we explain the Ayah about the Mubahalah [3:61] in this Surah, Allah willing. We should also state that we mentioned the virtues of Surah Āl-'Imrān along with the virtues of Surat Al-Baqarah in the beginning of the Tafsir of Surat Al-Baqarah. بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ الم…
Tafsir maududi_ur 3:2: اللہ، وہ زندہ جاوید ہستی، جو نظام کائنات کو سنبھالے ہوئے ہے، حقیقت میں اُس کے سوا کوئی خدا نہیں ہے

q-0934.answer:
Quran 8:14 — Al-Anfaal (The Spoils of War)

ذَٰلِكُمْ فَذُوقُوهُ وَأَنَّ لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ

Transliteration: Zaalikum fazooqoohu wa anna lilkaafireena 'azaaban Naar

Translation: "That [is yours], so taste it." And indeed for the disbelievers is the punishment of the Fire.

sources.snippet: Quran 8:14. Arabic: ذَٰلِكُمْ فَذُوقُوهُ وَأَنَّ لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ. English: "That [is yours], so taste it." And indeed for the disbelievers is the punishment of the Fire.. Urdu: یہ (مزہ تو یہاں) چکھو اور یہ (جانے رہو) کہ کافروں کے لیے (آخرت میں) دوزخ کا عذاب (بھی تیار) ہے.

Tafsir ibn_kathir_en 8:14: (Remember) when He covered you with a slumber as a security from Him, and He caused water (rain) to descend on you from the sky, to clean you thereby and to remove from you the Rijz (whispering or dirt) of Shaytan, and to strengthen your hearts, and make your feet firm thereby (11)(Remember) when your Lord revealed to the angels, "Verily, I am with you, so keep firm those who have believed. I will cast terror into the hearts of those who have disbelieved, so strike them over the necks, and smite over all their fingers and toes. (12)This is because they defied and di…
Tafsir maududi_ur 8:14: یہ ہے تم لوگوں کی سزا، اب اس کا مزا چکھو، اور تمہیں معلوم ہو کہ حق کا انکار کرنے والوں کے لیے دوزخ کا عذاب ہے

q-1111.answer:
Quran 15:40 — Al-Hijr (The Rock)

إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ

Transliteration: Illaa 'ibaadaka minhumul mukhlaseen

Translation: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."

sources.snippet: Quran 15:40. Arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ. English: Except, among them, Your chosen servants.". Urdu: ہاں ان میں جو تیرے مخلص بندے ہیں (ان پر قابو چلنا مشکل ہے).

Tafsir ibn_kathir_en 15:40: [Iblis] said: "O my Lord! Because You misled me, I shall indeed adorn the path of error for them (mankind) on the earth, and I shall mislead them all. (39)"Except Your chosen (guided) servants among them. (40)(Allah) said: "This is the way which will lead straight to Me. (41)"Certainly, you shall have no authority over My servants, except those of the astray who follow you. (42)And surely, Hell is the place promised for them all (43)It has seven gates, for each of those gates is a class assigned (44) The Threat of Iblis to tempt Mankind, and Allah's Promise of Hell…
Tafsir maududi_ur 15:40: سوائے تیرے اُن بندوں کے جنہیں تو نے اِن میں سے خالص کر لیا ہو"

q-1227.answer:
Quran 20:7 — Taa-Haa (Taa-Haa)

وَإِن تَجْهَرْ بِٱلْقَوْلِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ وَأَخْفَى

Transliteration: Allahu laaa ilaaha illaa Huwal Haiyul Qaiyoom; laa taakhuzuhoo sinatunw wa laa nawm; lahoo maa fissamaawaati wa maa fil ard; man zal lazee yashfa'u indahooo illaa bi-iznih; ya'lamu maa baina aydeehim wa mww khalfahum wa laa yuheetoona bishai'im min 'ilmihee illaa bimaa shaaa'; wasi'a Kursiyyuhus samaawaati wal arda wa laa ya'ooduho hifzuhumaa; wa Huwal Aliyyul 'Azeem

Translation: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.

Quran 42:3. Arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ يُوحِىٓ إِلَيْكَ وَإِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ. English: Thus has He revealed to you, [O Muhammad], and to those before you - Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.. Quran 42:26. Arabic: وَيَسْتَجِيبُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَيَزِيدُهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۭ. English: And He answers [the supplication of] those who have believed and done righteous deeds and increases [for] them from His bounty. But the disbelievers will have a severe punishment.. Urdu: اور جو ایمان لائے اور عمل نیک کئے ان کی (دعا) قبول فرماتا ہے اور ان کو اپنے فضل سے بڑھاتا ہے۔ اور جو کافر ہیں ان کے لئے سخت عذاب ہے.

Quran 48:16 — Al-Fath (The Victory)

قُل لِّلْمُخَلَّفِينَ مِنَ ٱلْأَعْرَابِ سَتُدْعَوْنَ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ أُو۟لِى بَأْسٍۢ شَدِيدٍۢ تُقَٰتِلُونَهُمْ أَوْ يُسْلِمُونَ ۖ فَإِن تُطِيعُوا۟ يُؤْتِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ أَجْرًا حَسَنًۭا ۖ وَإِن تَتَوَلَّوْا۟ كَمَا تَوَلَّيْتُم مِّن قَبْلُ يُعَذِّبْكُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۭا

Transliteration: Qul lilmukhallafeena minal A'raabi satud'awna ilaa qawmin ulee baasin shadeedin tuqaati loonahum aw yuslimoona fa in tutee'oo yu'tikumul laahu ajran hasananw wa in tatawallaw kamaa tawallaitum min qablu yu'azzibkum 'azaaban aleemaa

Translation: Say to those who remained behind of the bedouins, "You will be called to [face] a people of great military might; you may fight them, or they will submit. So if you obey, Allah will give you a good reward; but if you turn away as you turned away before, He will punish you with a painful punishment."
